  "maturity": "stable",
  "adaptation_hours_estimate": 20,
  "adaptation_confidence": "medium",
  "adaptation_assumptions": [
    "The component will be deployed as a standalone service.",
    "Integration with the defense architecture's specific MQTT brokers is not direct; Centrifugo uses its own protocol. Adaptation requires building an MQTT-to-Centrifugo bridge or using Centrifugo's HTTP/gRPC API for ingestion."
  ],
  "known_gaps": [
    "Native MQTT support: Centrifugo does not natively speak MQTT as a transport for clients (it uses WebSocket/SSE/gRPC). The requested 'Position & Telemetry Ingestion (in; MQTT)' and other MQTT interfaces require an external bridge or adapter.",
    "Specific Alert Processing Logic: Centrifugo handles message routing, not business logic like 'Alert Processing' or 'Geofence Violation' detection. These must be implemented in the backend consuming the messages."
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Protocol Mismatch: The requested interfaces rely heavily on MQTT. Centrifugo is not an MQTT broker. Using it as a direct replacement for MQTT requires significant architectural adaptation (bridges).",
    "Maintenance: While mature, integrating custom async consumers (Kafka/Postgres) requires Go development effort."
  ],
